pack.name: forge-formal-conformance-standin
pack.title: Forge conformance pack: formal follow-on (stand-in blocks; Forge evidence pending)
pack.scope: Built in a repository checkout that holds no Forge RTL and no Forge proof outputs. Recorded claims are formal results on stand-in blocks generated by the Amaranth HDL standard library; they say nothing about Forge hardware. Forge's published bit-exact claims are listed under Not recorded until their evidence files are added.

claims.statement: Stand-in SyncFIFO (width 8, depth 4): formal check of its documented contract
Stand-in SyncFIFO: every entry read equals the entry written, in order, for all 8-bit values
Stand-in GrayEncoder(8): output equals n XOR (n >> 1) for every 8-bit n; neighbours differ in one bit
Stand-in GrayDecoder(8): decoded output re-encodes to the input for every 8-bit input
Two generated stand-ins composed: decode(encode(n)) == n for every 8-bit n
Stand-in SyncFIFO: yosys-generated mutants caught by the contract properties (bmc)
Stand-in GrayEncoder(8): yosys-generated mutants caught by the contract properties
Stand-in GrayDecoder(8): yosys-generated mutants caught by the contract properties
Stand-in encoder+decoder pair: decoder mutants caught by the round-trip property
Control: the same FIFO spec without its ordering property, same 40 mutants
Stand-ins, all four property sets: share of non-equivalent mutants caught
Formal property checks on Forge's generated engine blocks
claims.evidence_needed: run formal/forge_formal.py on the engine RTL with one spec per block

claims.statement: Engine hardware equals the integer model, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct: 47 token positions, 411 checkpoints per token, 0 mismatches (simulation)
claims.claimed_in: index.html (public site, evidence as of 20 Nov 2026)
claims.evidence_needed: the proof run's summary JSON with compared and mismatches counts

claims.statement: Fast integer engine on a GPU gives the same integers: 479 of 479 intermediate values, Qwen2.5-7B, independent rerun
claims.claimed_in: index.html (public site, evidence as of 20 Nov 2026)
claims.evidence_needed: the rerun's comparison JSON with compared and mismatches counts

claims.statement: Rows with weights stored beside the multipliers: exact, 0.80 ns clock, 45 nm library, pre-layout
